commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity <<'ETC_INTEGRITY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STATE_DIR=/var/lib/etc-integrity
BASELINE=$STATE_DIR/baseline.tsv

make_manifest() {
    find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l \) -print | LC_ALL=C sort |
    while IFS= read -r path; do
        if [ -L "$path" ]; then
            meta=$(stat -c '%a:%u:%g:%s' "$path")
            digest=$(readlink "$path" | sha256sum)
            digest=${digest%% *}
            printf '%s\tL\t%s\t%s\n' "$path" "$meta" "$digest"
        elif [ -f "$path" ]; then
            meta=$(stat -c '%a:%u:%g:%s' "$path")
            digest=$(sha256sum "$path")
            digest=${digest%% *}
            printf '%s\tF\t%s\t%s\n' "$path" "$meta" "$digest"
        fi
    done
}

case "${1:-}" in
    init)
        umask 077
        install -d -m 0700 "$STATE_DIR"
        tmp=$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/baseline.XXXXXX")
        trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
        make_manifest > "$tmp"
        chmod 0600 "$tmp"
        mv -f "$tmp" "$BASELINE"
        trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
        count=$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")
        printf 'Baseline initialized: %s entries in %s\n' "$count" "$BASELINE"
        ;;
    check)
        if [ ! -r "$BASELINE" ]; then
            printf 'ERROR: baseline missing; run %s init\n' "$0" >&2
            exit 2
        fi
        umask 077
        tmp=$(mktemp "$STATE_DIR/current.XXXXXX")
        trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
        make_manifest > "$tmp"
        if awk -F '\t' '
            NR == FNR { old[$1] = $0; next }
            {
                if (!($1 in old)) {
                    printf "ADDED\t%s\n", $1
                    changes++
                } else {
                    if ($0 != old[$1]) {
                        printf "CHANGED\t%s\n", $1
                        changes++
                    }
                    delete old[$1]
                }
            }
            END {
                for (path in old) {
                    printf "REMOVED\t%s\n", path
                    changes++
                }
                if (changes == 0) {
                    print "OK\t/etc matches the integrity baseline"
                    exit 0
                }
                printf "SUMMARY\t%d change(s) detected\n", changes
                exit 1
            }
        ' "$BASELINE" "$tmp"; then
            rc=0
        else
            rc=$?
        fi
        rm -f "$tmp"
        trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
        exit "$rc"
        ;;
    status)
        if [ ! -r "$BASELINE" ]; then
            printf 'Baseline: missing\n'
            exit 2
        fi
        printf 'Baseline: %s\n' "$BASELINE"
        printf 'Entries: %s\n' "$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")"
        printf 'SHA256: '
        sha256sum "$BASELINE" | awk '{print $1}'
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'Usage: %s {init|check|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
ETC_INTEGRITY_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity
cat > /etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity <<'ETC_INTEGRITY_CRON_EOF'

/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity check

commands.command:
set -eu
target=/etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity
backup=$(mktemp /tmp/etc-integrity-probe.XXXXXX)
cp -p "$target" "$backup"
restore() { cp -p "$backup" "$target"; rm -f "$backup"; }
trap restore EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '\n# reversible integrity probe\n' >> "$target"
set +e
report=$(/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity check 2>&1)
rc=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$report"
printf 'CHECK_EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
[ "$rc" -eq 1 ]
printf '%s\n' "$report" | grep '^CHANGED[[:space:]]/etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity$'
restore
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'AFTER_RESTORE\n'
/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity check
